points.description: States that the company's capital structure (debt-equity mix / financing proportions, hence WACC) stays constant/unchanged.
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.75) for a vague idea such as 'WACC is constant' or 'financing mix stable' without naming capital structure/debt-equity proportions.

points.description: States that this holds over the projection (forecast) period.
points.partial_credit: Award in full for 'throughout the forecast/projection years' or equivalent; none if no time span is stated.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the company's capital structure stays the same over the projection/forecast period. Give part marks if the capital structure idea is vague (e.g. only 'WACC constant') or the projection period is missing. Give 0 for unrelated assumptions such as constant growth, constant tax rate or no risk.
